articles.title: Unvaccinated Pennsylvania woman died of measles complications, coroner says
articles.summary: A 40-year-old woman in Jefferson County, Pennsylvania has died of complications from measles, according to the county's coroner. It marks the third vaccine-preventable, measles-linked death in the US this year. All three have occurred in Pennsylvania, which is experiencing an explosive outbreak that has caused over 670 cases and 124 hospitalizations across 37 counties . Prior to these deaths, Pennsylvania had not reported a measles death in 35 years. In a news release dated September 12, Jefferson County Coroner Greg Furlong said the death in the woman was "a heartbreaking loss for the family and an unfortunate reminder that measles can be a serious and potentially life-threatening disease." articles.title: Super Smash Bros Melee now has a PC port, and the Android port isn’t far behind
articles.summary: TL;DR Super Smash Bros Melee has been unofficially ported to Windows. This comes just days after the game was fully decompiled, opening the door to fan ports. The developer also offers an Android port of the game, but it’s currently broken. Super Smash Bros Melee is one of the GameCube’s most popular games, and it was fully decompiled last week . This reverse-engineering process enables unofficial ports of the title to modern platforms. Now, we’ve got some more good news. Developer 999sian has ported Super Smash Bros Melee to Windows and Linux. The so-called melee-pc project builds on the work of the doldecomp group (which decompiled the game) and uses the Aurora graphics compatibility layer.

articles.title: I’ve used Android for 15 years — but I’m ready to switch to the iPhone Duo
articles.summary: I’ve been using some sort of Android phone for practically 15 years. As a technology journalist and enthusiast, I’ve seen the entire gamut of Symbian, Tizen, Android phones, and, yes, iPhones too. Along the way, I’ve also spent a fair amount of time with the best foldable phones on the market. I’ve even liked a few. But until now, I’ve never really bought into the hype. It’s a good idea in theory. Being able to turn a phone into a tablet when you need more screen real estate, be it for media consumption or multitasking, sounds incredible. But, so far, the hardware and software integration hasn’t quite hit the spot for me. Something always felt amiss.

articles.title: This hidden Shizuku upgrade solves the app’s most annoying background bug
articles.summary: If I had to compile a list of essential third-party Android apps , Shizuku would be near, if not at, the very top. It serves an often-overlooked but important purpose: providing other apps with access to otherwise inaccessible APIs, enabling them to perform powerful tasks. If you aren’t familiar with Shizuku’s game, it powers apps like Canta, my preferred Android uninstallation app that easily rids phones of preinstalled bloatware. Then there’s Adaptive Theme , which automatically switches between light and dark themes based on ambient light conditions. I have a good dozen apps on my phone that rely on Shizuku to function.

articles.summary: Credit: Mishaal Rahman / Android Authority TL;DR Google’s Advanced Protection mode currently clubs several security features that users can’t opt out of individually, except for Intrusion Logging. We’ve now discovered that Google is preparing to move USB Protection, Intrusion Detection, and Unsecured Wi-Fi Networks into an optional “Expert features” section. The change could give users more flexibility while retaining Advanced Protection’s strongest protections for those who want them. Google introduced Advanced Protection with Android 16 as a way for users to enable some of the strongest security and privacy protections on their devices. The feature is designed to protect against everything from harmful apps and online attacks to unauthorized access and other security risks.

articles.summary: An LLM can answer the same question a thousand times and charge you each time. articles.summary: Stonehenge is the most famous example of megalithic architecture across Britain and Ireland, but there are plenty of others, including Calanais, Newgrange, and Avebury, as well as the Devil's Arrows. articles.summary: In the badlands of Chakwal, in north-central Pakistan, Bestway Cement is transforming plots of dry earth and olive and peach groves into a forest of solar panels.
